architecture_summary: Restructure page.jsx into a clean two-tier layout: static Hero outside 3D wrapper, and interactive Device Frame containing internal sections (01 About, 02 Projects, 03 System, 04 Contact, Footer) rendered directly in React with native scroll container and Framer Motion 3D transforms.

rationale.state_and_context: Direct React components share Next.js context, theme variables, fonts, SWR cache, and React 19 hooks seamlessly without postMessage serialization.
rationale.performance_and_bundle: Zero bundle duplication. An iframe would reload the entire Next.js runtime, Tailwind CSS, font assets, and Lenis engine (~500KB+ duplicate transfer).
rationale.visual_rendering: Eliminates iframe white flashes, layout shifts (CLS), and 3D transform scroll jitter/compositing bugs in Chromium/Safari.
rationale.accessibility_and_seo: DOM remains natively traversable by screen readers (WCAG 2.1 AA) and search engine crawlers without iframe boundary blocking.

elements: BlurText description ('I automate the boring parts...')
